body.name: Exact rectangular detectability and absorption phase
body.construction:
For \(\eta\in\mathcal E_{\mathrm{loc}}\), set
\[
C_\eta=
\begin{pmatrix}
0&|\mu_a|\sqrt{v_b}\\
|\mu_b|\sqrt{v_a}&\sqrt{v_av_b}
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
h_{\mathrm{crit}}(\eta)
=\frac{c^{1/4}}{\kappa s_1(C_\eta)}.
\]
The denominator is positive on \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{loc}}\).  Define the bounded-experiment absorption phase by
\[
\mathcal A_{\mathrm{abs}}
=\left\{(\eta,h)\in\mathcal E_{\mathrm{loc}}\times[-\overline h,\overline h]:
|h|>h_{\mathrm{crit}}(\eta)\right\}.
\]
